p3_b0.ocr: In the first quarter of 2024, Veolia Environnement reported a Total Revenue of $120.5M, reflecting a Year-over-Year Change of 5.4% and a Market Share of 30.1% in North America, with a Treatment Type classified as Biological and an Efficiency of 92.5%.

p3_b1.ocr: The Operating Costs for this period amounted to $75.3M, representing a Year-over-Year Change of 2.1%, and a Market Share of 20.4% in North America, utilizing a Chemical Treatment Type with an Efficiency of 87.8%. The Net Profit recorded was $45.2M, showing a Year-over-Year Change of 7.8% and a Market Share of 15.3% in North America, associated with a Physical Treatment Type and an Efficiency of 90.1%.
